intro.h2: From a 70s eyesore to a room you love
paragraphs: Compass Bath and Remodel handles bathroom remodeling in Utah, from new vanities to full master bath rebuilds. One client's dad had a master bath with 70s shag carpet, a rotting subfloor and a dropped ceiling. Russ turned it into what she called a royal jewel of a space, with blue stone-look tile and brass fixtures.

Reviewers also talk about how the job is run. Russ comes out in person, listens to your ideas and adds his own. One client had a draft plan and estimate the next day. During the work, Russ tells you what to expect in the coming week, and clients say each step is well coordinated.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Utah, start to finish

items.name: Master bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Full master bath remodels, including the hard parts: rotted subfloors, old dropped ceilings and dated layouts. One recent job paired a glass walk-in shower in blue stone-look tile and brushed brass with a dark wood double vanity and oval brass mirrors.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with frosted glass sliding door on a brass rail, blue stone-look wall tile and brass shower set

items.name: Walk-in showers
items.blurb: New walk-in showers with built-in niches, a seat and grab bars where you need them. One shower uses large marble-look wall panels, a built-in bench, a recessed niche and a handheld shower on a slide bar, so it is easy to use every day.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with marble-look wall panels, built-in seat, recessed niche, grab bars and handheld shower

items.name: Vanity replacement
items.blurb: New vanities, tops, faucets and mirrors that update a bathroom without a full gut. Past jobs include a dark wood double vanity with a white top and oval brass mirrors, and a white double vanity with a wide mirror and a four-light fixture.

image.alt: Dark wood double vanity with white top, brushed brass faucets and two oval brass mirrors

items.name: Soaking tubs
items.blurb: A new tub can change the whole feel of a master bath. In one remodel, Russ's crew set a deep white soaking tub into a wide ledge under a large window, so the bath gets daylight and a view while you soak.

image.alt: White soaking tub set into a wide ledge beneath a large window, with chrome tub filler

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Bathrooms are the main work, but Compass also remodels kitchens, and kitchen remodels come up in several of its Google reviews. Call Russ to talk through cabinets, counters and layout, and ask to see photos of recent kitchen projects.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a remodeled kitchen in a suburban Utah home: warm white shaker cabinets, a matte black island with a light quartz top, brushed brass pulls and faucet, simple white tile backsplash, light oak-look floor, soft natural daylight from a window over the sink with blurred mountains outside. No people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Bright kitchen with warm white shaker cabinets, black island and brass hardware (illustration)

about.text: Compass Bath and Remodel, LLC is led by Russ Nay. The work is mostly bathrooms, with kitchens as well. Russ meets clients in person, walks the space and works out the plan with them before the crew starts. Clients describe him as quick to respond, flexible and someone with an eye for detail who does not miss a thing. His associates get the same praise: personable and professional. One homeowner enjoyed watching the process and is keeping Russ's number handy for the next project.

items.name: Sarah I.
items.text: Russ at Compass Bath and Remodel did a fantastic job working with us on my dad's master bath remodel. He made a 70s era shag carpet disaster with a rotting subfloor and a dropped ceiling into a royal jewel of a space. He was communicative, letting us know what to expect in the upcoming week, responsive to our questions, patient with our unique situation, and up to the task of coming up with creative solutions to what became a bespoke situation. I would definitely recommend Russ and team.

items.name: RP D.
items.text: I stumbled on Compass Bath and Remodel quite by accident, and I’m glad I did. Russ Nay and his associates did a tremendous job remodeling my master bath. I got a great impression of Russ from the start. He was quick to respond, showed up in person to survey the job, listened intently to my ideas, offered up some of his own, and had a draft plan and estimate ready the next day. He has an eye for detail, and didn’t miss a thing. Russ was flexible and adaptable, and each step in the process was well coordinated. He and all of his associates were very personable and professional. I actually enjoyed watching the process; it was a great experience. I’ll be keeping his contact info readily available so I can call him again for future projects.

items.name: Jeff M.
items.text: Compass Bath and Remodel did our recent bathroom remodel. My wife and I are very happy with the results. Russ and the rest of his crew were awesome! The communication with us before the remodel started until the completion of the project was great. It was obvious he cared about us being satisfied with the work and time frame in which it would be completed. We would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a remodel.

service_area.text: Compass Bath and Remodel is a Utah remodeling company. Russ comes to your home to survey the job in person, so the first step happens in your own bathroom or kitchen. Call (801) 678-2880 with your city and a short description of the project, and he can tell you whether it fits his schedule. Compass is open Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.

items.q: What projects do you take on?
items.a: Mostly bathrooms: full master bath remodels, walk-in showers, soaking tubs and vanity replacements. Compass also remodels kitchens. In its Google reviews, bathroom remodels come up most often, followed by kitchen remodels, walk-in showers and vanity replacement. If your project is something else, call and ask.

items.q: My bathroom has old damage. Can you still remodel it?
items.a: Yes. One master bath had 70s shag carpet, a rotting subfloor and a dropped ceiling, and Russ rebuilt it into a bright new room with a glass walk-in shower. The family said he came up with creative solutions when the job turned into a bespoke situation.

items.q: How quickly do I get a plan and estimate?
items.a: Russ visits in person to survey the job, listens to your ideas and then prepares a draft plan and estimate. One client said he had both ready the day after the visit. Call (801) 678-2880 to set up the visit at a time that works for you.

items.q: Will I know what is happening during the remodel?
items.a: Clients say yes. Russ lets you know what to expect in the upcoming week and responds quickly to questions. One couple said communication was great from before the remodel started until it was finished, and that he clearly cared about the work and the timeline.

Compass is open Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (801) 678-2880 during those hours, or email russ.compassbathandremodel@gmail.com any time with a few photos of your bathroom and a short note about what you want to change.
